Ich bin Elena. Anthropologin, Yoga-Lehre: I’m Elena. An anthropologist, yoga teacher, singer and someone who keeps asking questions, learning and exploring.
Ich bin in Freiburg geboren, als Tochter: I was born in Freiburg to a German Catholic mother and an Israeli Jewish father. Growing up with these different roots brought me into contact with questions of belonging, memory and home from an early age.
In Berlin habe ich Sozial- und Kulturant: I studied social and cultural anthropology in Berlin. I’m fascinated by the different ways people live, find meaning and shape their relationship with nature.
Meine Arbeit verbindet diese Neugier mit: My work brings this curiosity together with yoga, personal guidance and creative expression. I am a Yoga Alliance-certified Hatha Yoga and Yoga Nidra teacher. Voice, writing and time in nature are closely connected for me.
